retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style portrait composition featuring a textured, cool-toned background and tight, multi-colored sans-serif typography in the upper corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a smiling man in a dark textured coat and white collared shirt, set against a grainy teal-green background with bold, stacked sans-serif text in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center to the right to balance text on the left
High contrast between the dark coat and the bright white shirt collar
Text colors (cyan, orange, white) pop against the muted teal background
Grainy film texture unifies the subject and the background
coreInvariants: Warm skin tones contrasting with cool background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-shot portrait, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smile and eyes serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold text in the top left, move down to the subject's face, and follow the line of the white shirt collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant is used as active negative space for typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal-green background with grainy texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black textured coat and white shirt collar.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and orange-red used for primary text lines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, low-saturation background allows high-value white and saturated text accents to stand out.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Exclamation point integrated as a graphic element
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying colors and weights for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Large white exclamation point/teardrop shape as a punctuation graphic

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century grotesque weight and tight spacing.
Provides the clean, geometric structure typical of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with dark wavy hair, smiling, wearing a black wool coat and a white collared shirt, set against a grainy, dark teal textured studio background. Apply a 1960s film stock effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of bold sans-serif text in the top-left corner. Line 1 in cyan, Line 2 in orange-red, Line 3 in white. Use tight leading and tracking. Include a large white teardrop-shaped exclamation mark to the right of the text.

verificationChecks: Text is stacked in the top-left corner
Background has a visible grainy texture
Subject is wearing a dark, heavy-textured coat
Color palette includes cyan, orange, and teal

mustRedesign: Do not use contemporary sans-serifs like Roboto
Ensure the coat texture is visible and not a flat black
postGenerationChecks: Is the grain consistent across the image?
Is the text tracking tight enough to feel vintage?
Does the white collar provide a strong visual break?
Is the teal background sufficiently muted?
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Portrait + Grainy Teal Background + Stacked Bold Sans-Serif + Tight Kerning
